label: Rowe's WhollyGood satisfies the outcome-minimizing standard (WHOLLY_GOOD_1)
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Every Rowe-wholly-good being, for each occurring event it can prevent, is such that preventing it would not be strictly better than permitting it. The comparison is a supplied primitive.
